title: GR180 version E single can combustor (reverse flow, vertical, cool casing)

liner.material: 2.4951 alloy 75 (VDM) sheet 1.5 mm (or 2.4665 alloy X), laser-cut flat patterns, rolled + TIG, thermal-barrier coat optional

film.build: 4 machined slot rings (turned 2.4951 alloy 75 (VDM), 48 x d4.0 metering holes each) welded between the rolled liner sections

swirler.type: axial, 12 flat 1.5 mm vanes at 45 deg slotted into turned hub 50 / tip 110 rings

injector.type: central gas lance with 8 radial jets into the swirler exit (partially premixed diffusion flame), 1.4404 + 2.4665 tip

liner.material: 2.4951 alloy 75 (VDM) sheet 1.5 mm (or 2.4665 alloy X), laser-cut flat patterns, rolled + TIG, thermal-barrier coat optional

film.build: 4 machined slot rings (turned 2.4951 alloy 75 (VDM), 48 x d4.0 metering holes each) welded between the rolled liner sections

hot_section_life.plan: inspection (borescope: liner, transition, nozzle, wheel LE) every 8,000 h; liner + transition exchange at ~69 kh at 770 C; nozzle ring at ~80 kh; turbine wheel creep is not limiting at 770 C - wheel life is set by LCF (starts, est >= 10,000) and by the supplier rating; every hour at 850 C counts as ~7 h at 770 C for the liner / nozzle

nox.basis: diffusion-type primary zone at phi_pz 0.65 (T_pz 1545 C), P3 4 bar, T3 212 C: comparable small single-can industrial GTs without water injection 80-150 ppm; low P3 / T3 lowers it (estimate, measure on the rig)
nox.v2: lean-premixed swirler (phi_pz ~0.55-0.6, premix tube, pilot) for <= 25 ppm: flashback / acoustics development - later version

ignition.igniter: industrial gas-engine spark plug in a cooled sleeve (M18x1.5 boss), high-energy capacitive coil (MOTORTECH DE / NGK JP plug)
ignition.position: primary zone, 0.35 x L_pz from the dome, 30 deg off the top
ignition.light_off: motored by the PMG at ~20-25 % speed, phi_pz ~1 at light-off

flame_detection: UV flame scanner on a sight tube through the dome (DURAG DE, Siemens QRA class) + 2 EGT thermocouples in the diffuser
removal: top flange DN350 PN10: lift the dome + injector + liner out upward (no engine strip); transition duct stays in the hot plenum (spigot + piston ring)
